title: Chapter 665
text:
Race Evolution also had the effect of changing talents. After the evolution, Han Xiao's Race Talents changed as well.

[Advanced Void Travel] was the universal talent of all Void species, so it did not change. However, [Void Vision — Observer], [Chaos Entity Release], and [Observer's Mark] were all replaced by Void Distorter's abilities.

There were also three new talents — [Void Molt], [Void Distortion], and [Void Ripple].

[Void Molt] was an enhancement type ability. Due to the cells being modified by the void energy, the void genes would be strengthened. By burning energy with the 'void' attribute, one could enter an explosive state, increasing all their attributes and strengthening the void attribute of their energy.

Han Xiao's current silver-skinned, blue-striped, and black-eyed appearance was the result of activating this ability. His entire person looked very empty … no, it was void.

Void Distorter's signature talent was [Void Distortion]. It could affect reality by pulling in the void dimension. It was a large-scale AOE skill that consumed a lot of mana to maintain. It could also cause a psychological impact to enemies within its range.

With his current strength, the range and power of [Void Distortion] were very impressive. It could be used as a normal combat method in battles of the same level.

At this moment, the whirlpool was a phenomenon of Void Distortion that affected the outside world. It caught Stephanie off guard and spun her around. Her brain almost spilled out of her head.

[Void Ripple] was a single-target damage skill. It compressed and twisted the power of the Void, causing the power to be condensed and extremely explosive. Even Han Xiao's heart skipped a beat when he saw the theoretical damage. Most of this ability was True Damage.

Chaos Observer is mainly a support ability, while Void Distorter is a pure battle-type talent. It involves the power of space and is good at destruction, Han Xiao thought.

Most of Void Distorter's abilities were related to space. Together with the changes brought by the Void energy, this Race Evolution had brought him a total of four abilities. Furthermore, this was the first time he had evolved. His potential had increased tremendously, giving him a lot of attributes.

Han Xiao pulled the Void Dimension with both hands, maintaining the whirlpool that was twisting the Void. He took the opportunity to observe the changes in his attributes after the Race Evolution.

Every Race Evolution was a dividing line in terms of strength. He did some calculations. This time, he had gained a total of + 132 STR, + 224 DEX, + 220 END, + 507 INT, + 169 MYS, + 34 CHA, + 5850 Energy, and + 11300 STR.

The effect was off the charts!

Han Xiao was extremely satisfied. He looked at his attribute interface.

Level: 195

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Void Distorter (Human Form)

Attributes: 468 STR, 898 DEX, 940 END, 2,633 INT, 432 MYS, 139 CHA, 1 LUX

Free Attribute Points: 0

Potential Points: 15

Health: 196560

Stamina: 154720

Energy: 25530 [Lv.12]

Lv.12 Energy Bonuses: + 169 STR, + 239 DEX, + 269 END, + 336 INT, + 206 MYS, + 32520 Stamina Limit, + 352% Machinery Affinity (Super Electromagnetic Induction)

Energy Rank: 20170

Grade: A +

You're a Grade A + Mechanic … It's a pity that your brain is filled with muscles.

Muscles my ass! My brain is full of wisdom, okay?!

Han Xiao curled his lips and did not want to lower himself to the same level as the remark.

Level 195. I've finally reached Grade A +.

Han Xiao looked at his Experience Storage. He had spent a lot of Experience to level up fifteen times in a row. At this stage, every level up required an astronomical amount of Experience.

He estimated that the remaining Experience Storage would allow him to level up more than ten times.

After reaching Grade A +, his combat capability would skyrocket. Before his Promotion, he would be able to fight against ninety percent of the Calamity Grade Supers. Now, Han Xiao estimated that there would not be many people at the same level that he would be afraid of.

He was already at the top of the Calamity Grade Supers!

However, as the saying went, 'Flirtatious words come out of your mouth, but you're actually hiding it in your heart.' For the time being, Han Xiao had no intention of provoking a Beyond Grade A Super.

Level 195 was comparable to a top Calamity Grade Supers, but he would only be able to reach Beyond Grade A Super when he was around level 240. Just this difference of dozens of levels made Han Xiao not want to cause trouble.

This was dozens of levels in the late stage. The difference between levels was much greater than in the early stage!

With my current strength, I'll only be able to play around a little. Han Xiaoxin's state was stable. It was impossible for him to become arrogant.

This time, more than half of his energy was used up. Han Xiao stopped distorting the void. The huge whirlpool was still there, but the speed of the whirlpool had slowed down. Without Han Xiao's Void Energy pulling her, Stephanie regained control of her body. She immediately got rid of the whirlpool and charged out of the sea.

Han Xiao followed behind her and slowly flew into the sky.

Wilton and the others saw that the two of them had finally left the sea. They all looked over and were shocked. Han Xiao looked like a Pugilist with silver flames burning all over his body, while Stephanie was drenched and covered in wounds. She looked extremely haggard with fear still lingering on her face.

Everyone understood. The two of them had obviously fought at the bottom of the sea. No one knew what ability Black Star had used to create such a huge commotion. It looked like Stephanie had suffered a huge loss.

"Go!"

Han Xiao led the Mech Legion and charged forward, not giving Stephanie any time to catch her breath.

His strength had increased tremendously, and he had recovered through his Promotion. He immediately broke the fragile balance between the two of them and blew the horn to counterattack!

The increase in Intelligence increased the combat capability of the Mech Legion once again.

Boom boom boom!

The battle started again. Han Xiao entered the battle again and immediately overturned the stalemate.

After his Promotion, he immediately suppressed Stephanie and even had the strength to support his teammates. He controlled the rhythm of the battle by himself.

The scales of victory slowly tilted.

Stephanie felt the pressure increase drastically. She was completely on the defensive. Her face was filled with fear. She did not understand why Black Star had suddenly become so much stronger when they were on par earlier. Was this his hidden trump card?

Could it be that he could use battle to nurture battle and grow quickly in battle?

She remembered that there were similar battle races in the universe. What could not kill them would make them stronger.

Was Black Star also such a person?

That made sense. No wonder Black Star had risen so quickly. He was probably one of those battle races with extraordinary talent!

Many guesses flashed through Stephanie's mind. She looked back at her teammates who were covered in wounds and hesitated.

Including her, everyone was already at the end of their rope. However, Black Star was still alive, and the helpers he called were also very difficult to deal with. After fighting for so long, Stephanie still could not see any hope of capturing Black Star.

"Retreat!"

Seeing that the situation was not good, Stephanie decided to retreat. She called her teammates and wanted to leave the battlefield.

However, after fighting for a few hours, Stephanie and the others were exhausted. If they chose to fight head-on, they could have lasted for a long time. However, once they thought about retreating, they lost their drive and lost all their advantage. They were held back by Han Xiao, who was at his peak after his Promotion.

Han Xiao cooperated with Wilton and the others. They were a group of annoying little demons. Stephanie and the others retreated as they fought. They entered a vicious cycle where the more they wanted to retreat, the more passive they were. They felt like their bodies were hollowed out, and they could not escape.

However, fighting head-on would only result in a slow death. Stephanie could only choose to retreat. Only then did she realize that she was in a dilemma. In the few hours of stalemate, they had exhausted too much energy because of Black Star. It was too late.

If the enemy had retreated from the beginning, Han Xiao would not have been able to stop Stephanie and the others. However, it was too late to escape now!

Han Xiao was well versed in boiling the frog in warm water. Now was the time to put the lid on the pot!

He did not want these dangerous people to escape. Who knew what kind of trouble they would cause next time?

When Stephanie realized what was going on, they had nowhere to run!

The battlefield gradually shifted to land. Stephanie and the others finally reached the critical point.

Han Xiao immediately activated his slaughter mode!

Bang!

He punched a heavily injured enemy Mage. Void Ripples surged into the target's body. This person's body shook violently. His body twisted like a fried dough twist, and blood spurted out. His health dropped to zero, and he fell into the rift.

Swoosh!

A Psionic Impact shot into the body of an enemy Esper. A dark blue ball of light expanded from his body. With a boom, this person exploded from the inside out, turning into blood!

Dong!

A heavy knee landed on the lower body of a Pugilist. A large number of nanoparticles suddenly appeared on the knee, turning into a high-frequency particle vibration blade. As the knee pierced into the body of this Pugilist, who had lost his energy defense, the nanoparticle blade quickly changed shape. The next moment, countless alloy spikes extended from the inside out, penetrating his muscles. It was as if his entire body had grown spikes.

This only lasted for an instant. Han Xiao quickly retreated, and the nanoparticles retracted. The spikes on this person's body were all 'retracted'. Blood spurted out from countless small holes, and he fell to the ground like a broken sack.

One Calamity Grade Super after another was killed by Han Xiao. Only Stephanie was left to resist. Her strength was indeed shocking. Even if she was alone, she still caused quite a bit of trouble for everyone.

However, it was difficult to fight alone.

Stephanie heavily injured three of her helpers. This was the last trouble she caused, and she was also defeated by Han Xiao. There was no exception.

The few helpers risked their injuries and held her down tightly, unable to break free.

Han Xiao pressed Stephanie, whose clothes were not even covering her body, onto the ground. Psionic Impact did not stop, shooting one Psionic Impact after another at her face. Stephanie was held down by Wilton and the others, unable to resist. She could only let Han Xiao ravage her body.

Han Xiao was having a great time. He just had to shoot her to death. This was the charm of a group fight!

In the end, Stephanie was heavily injured and on the verge of death. She could not move at all. Her chest heaved up and down, and she only had half a breath left.

Han Xiao did not kill her. He felt that it was still useful to keep her alive. Furthermore, Stephanie was a boss-level character, so it would be very useful to bring her back to be squeezed.

Stephanie felt that her eyelids were extremely heavy. Before she fainted, she gathered her last bit of energy and looked at Han Xiao with hatred.

When she was setting up the ambush, she did not even consider the possibility that she would die here.

"Black Star …"

Stephanie stared at Han Xiao, carving Han Xiao's image into her heart. Then, her eyes rolled back, and she fainted.

The whole place fell silent, leaving only dust floating in the air.

"We finally won." Han Xiao exhaled. Only then did he feel the tiredness in his body. He just wanted to lie down and have a good sleep.

To be honest, Stephanie's trap was indeed very threatening. If he did not call for help in advance, he might have really been tricked. If he had advanced in advance and did not have the Observer's Mark to choose the battlefield, Black Star City would have been destroyed for sure.

Unfortunately, the battle was already over. The result was set.

Stephanie's team was wiped out!

"Thank you for your help." Han Xiao turned around and looked at Wilton and the others. He nodded at them.

"You're welcome."

Wilton swallowed his saliva and did not dare be slow. He originally had some plans in mind, but now, he was only wary of Han Xiao.

This time, it was not as shocking as fighting the eight Vanguard Officials head-on. However, in this battle, how many Calamity Grades had Black Star killed?

Black Star had proven his ability to take hits the last time, and today, Wilton witnessed Han Xiao's lethality for the first time.

Just thinking about it made Wilton's heart turn cold.

Thankfully, Black Star is our ally … Wilton secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

On the other side, Nagojin's face was sad. One of his comrades had died, and Han Xiao could not comfort him. He patted his shoulder.

Godora had sent people to help him. One of their Calamity Grade Supers had died in battle, which was not a small loss for Godora. Han Xiaoxin felt apologetic and remembered this favor. He secretly thought about how to compensate Godora and deepen their bond.

He was not someone who accepted help from others and took it for granted.

Connections were something that could only be maintained if there was a reciprocal relationship.

At this time, Han Xiao suddenly thought of something, and his expression changed.

"By the way, we can't rest yet. Philip, gather the disaster report and tell me the location."

Han Xiao forced himself to stay alert, turned into a rainbow, and quickly left.

He could not slack off now. He still had to deal with the disasters brought about by the battle. If he did not stop it in time, Blue Star would also be greatly damaged.
